title: Solve a Real Problem
text: The best businesses solve a problem people already have. Before building anything, talk to potential customers and learn what frustrates them.

title: Start Small and Validate
text: Don't spend thousands of dollars on an idea before proving people will buy it. Create a simple version of your product or service and test demand first.

title: Know Your Target Customer
text: Trying to serve everyone usually means serving no one. Define who your ideal customer is, what problems they face, and what they value most.

title: Track Every Dollar
text: Many businesses fail because they run out of cash. Create a budget, monitor expenses, and understand where your money is going from day one.

title: Choose the Right Business Model
text: Understand how your business will generate revenue. Whether you sell products, services, subscriptions, or advertising, your path to profitability should be clear.

title: Build a Professional Brand
text: A clear business name, logo, and message help customers trust you. Consistency across your website, social media, and marketing materials is key.

title: Learn Basic Sales Skills
text: Even the best products need effective sales. Learn how to communicate value, handle objections, and confidently ask customers to make a purchase.

title: Focus on Customer Feedback
text: Your customers can provide valuable insights about what is working and what needs improvement. Listen carefully and use their feedback to guide decisions.

title: Document Your Processes
text: Write down how recurring tasks are completed. Documented processes save time, improve consistency, and make it easier to train future team members.

title: Build Relationships Early
text: Strong relationships with customers, suppliers, mentors, and business partners can open doors to opportunities, advice, and long-term growth.
